name: Rose Keep — surface and detail kit
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Rose-pink keep on an irregular rock ledge, cylindrical turrets with burgundy conical roofs, arched windows/portal, stepped exterior terraces and dense rose climbers. Miniature plan has projecting round tower seats; isometric extends castle along raised rock shoulders. Hidden layout inference: A short winding stair climbs to a sheltered entry terrace, then a compact courtyard between attached towers. Outer rose walk follows cliff return and reconnects at gate; keep tower windows clear and use restrained gold rose-banner accents. Hidden rear court is an inference. Preserve this local design. Exactly12 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B04-DETAIL-001 — Rose Keep — surface and detail kit". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need irregular stone/fort-wall returns, cylindrical tower-wall window bands, cone roof seats, stair-to-terrace corners and climbing-rose attachment layout. Source roofs, rose relief, pink masonry and banners already supply detail vocabulary. Pollinators/robins inhabit planted ledges. Missing detached construction pieces and local interior-facing patterns.
